description: This file defines a React component class 'MarketplaceItemPlugin' for rendering plugin marketplace items, including update prompts, installation, configuration, and modal dialogs for plugin updates. It includes related functional components for version display and update confirmation modals.

classes.name: MarketplaceItemPlugin
classes.description: A React component class that displays a plugin item in the marketplace, handling installation, updates, configuration, and modal dialogs.

methods.name: showUpdateConfirmationModal
methods.description: Sets state to show the update confirmation modal.

methods.name: hideUpdateConfirmationModal
methods.description: Sets state to hide the update confirmation modal.

methods.name: onInstall
methods.description: Triggers plugin installation via props actions.

methods.name: onConfigure
methods.description: Triggers closing the marketplace modal for plugin configuration.

methods.name: onUpdate
methods.description: Handles plugin update action, hides modal, and triggers installation.

methods.name: getItemButton
methods.description: Returns the appropriate action button (configure or install) based on plugin state.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the plugin marketplace item, including version info, update details, and update confirmation modal.
